purpose: Controls deliberately left without a CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations citation. Each was reviewed on 2026-10-25 against the v7.0.0 audit procedure: either no recommendation describes what the evaluator checks, or the evaluator passes a state the recommendation's audit fails (a looser threshold, a different setting, or fewer of the settings the recommendation lists), so citing it would credit the client with a recommendation the tool did not verify. An empty citation is more accurate than a stretched one. TP.FrameworkCoverage.Tests.ps1 accepts an empty CIS citation only for a control listed here, and fails if a listed control gains one (remove it from this list when a reviewed citation is added).

controls.AAD-1.1: Closest 5.2.2.3, but the evaluator scores Satisfied (a) whenever Security Defaults is on, with no CA policy at all, and (b) for a CA block policy whose ClientAppTypes contains only 'other' (filter is `-contains 'other'`), while 5.2.2.3 requires an enabled CA policy whose ClientAppTypes contains BOTH exchangeActiveSync AND other with BuiltInControls block; both Satisfied states fail R.
controls.AAD-1.3: Closest 5.2.2.5: grant check matches (allowed combinations only fido2/windowsHelloForBusiness/x509CertificateMultiFactor, all applications), but role coverage is judged against the collector's 17-name privRoleNames list, which lacks Global Reader and Password Administrator from 5.2.2.5's 15-role minimum, so a policy omitting those two roles scores Satisfied and fails R; also accepts an All-users policy where R's Graph audit requires IncludeRoles.
controls.AAD-2.1: Checks that three CA tracks (legacy block, MFA all users, admin MFA) plus the approved NRG template set are enforced; no v7 recommendation covers "a CA policy set is deployed", and the per-track recs are cited (or not) on AAD-1.1/1.2/1.3.
controls.AAD-2.3: Closest 5.2.2.9: Satisfied for enabled all-users/all-apps policies whose grant necessarily involves compliantDevice OR domainJoinedDevice (Test-TPCAGrantRequires), so a hybrid-join-only policy or "compliantDevice AND mfa" passes; R requires BuiltInControls to contain compliantDevice, contain nothing but compliantDevice/domainJoinedDevice, and Operator OR.
controls.AAD-3.2: Closest 5.3.1: Satisfied when no user/group permanent assignment remains in the collector's 17 named privileged roles, setting aside any number of CA-excluded cloud-only GA "break-glass" accounts and ignoring service principals; R uses every isPrivileged role, allows at most 2 permanent break-glass GA assignments, and requires service-principal assignments to be time-bound.
controls.AAD-3.3: PIM activation MFA per role policy; no v7 recommendation audits it (5.3.1 mentions MFA at activation only in its description, its audit checks assignment state).
controls.AAD-3.4: PIM activation justification; no v7 recommendation audits it.
controls.AAD-3.6: PIM maximum activation duration <= 8 hours; no v7 recommendation audits activation duration.
controls.AAD-6.2: Closest 5.1.5.1: the evaluator scores Satisfied when ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf.microsoft-user-default-low is assigned ("limited to low-impact permissions from verified publishers"), and 5.1.5.1 fails the audit if -low (or -legacy) is present.
controls.AAD-8.1: Always NotApplicable manual review of PIM alerts; no v7 recommendation covers PIM alerts.
controls.AAD-8.2: Closest 5.3.3: Satisfied when any one access review that targets roles is in an active status; R requires a review for each of 6 named privileged roles, Eligible and Active scope, monthly or more frequent, <= 14 days, auto-apply, defaultDecision None, reminders and justification.
controls.AAD-9.2: Checks that a passwordless method (FIDO2, Authenticator phone sign-in or CBA) is enabled; no v7 recommendation requires passwordless availability (5.2.3.5 is about disabling weak methods).
controls.AAD-10.1: Closest 5.2.2.6: Satisfied for any enabled CA policy with any UserRiskLevels value, with no check of users, applications, the high level, the grant (passwordChange + mfa) or sign-in frequency everyTime.
controls.AAD-10.2: Closest 1.1.1: Satisfied when no account in the collector's 17 named privileged roles is OnPremisesSyncEnabled; 1.1.1 covers every role named "*Administrator*" plus Global Reader, so a synced Hybrid Identity Administrator, Password Administrator or Global Reader passes the tool and fails R.
controls.AAD-11.1: Closest 5.2.2.12: the CA path matches (enabled, transferMethods contains deviceCodeFlow, block, all users/all apps), but the evaluator also scores Satisfied when Security Defaults is on with no CA policy, which fails R's "a policy exists" audit.
controls.AAD-11.2: No guests (#EXT#) in privileged roles; no v7 recommendation covers guests holding admin roles.
controls.AAD-11.3: Identity Protection risky service principals; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-11.5: CAE strict enforcement session control; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-11.6: Cross-tenant default inbound trust (MFA / compliant device); no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-11.7: Any enabled role-scoped CA policy with a device filter or device grant; no v7 recommendation covers admin device scoping (5.2.2.9 is all users).
controls.AAD-11.8: Terms of Use grant control; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-11.9: CA policy for workload identities; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-12.2: Guests with no sign-in in 90 days; no v7 recommendation covers stale guests (5.3.2 audits guest access-review configuration).
controls.AAD-12.3: Licensed members with no sign-in in 90 days; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-12.4: Inventory of tenant-wide (AllPrincipals) delegated consent grants; no v7 recommendation covers existing grants (5.1.5.1 audits the user consent setting).
controls.AAD-13.1: Microsoft Secure Score against peer average; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.AAD-14.1: Closest 5.1.5.4 / 5.1.5.6: the evaluator inspects existing credentials (none expired, none expiring within 30 days, none issued for > 180 days, and Satisfied when there are none), while R audits the defaultAppManagementPolicy restriction (passwordLifetime / asymmetricKeyLifetime enabled, <= 180 days); a tenant with no policy passes the tool.
controls.AAD-15.1: No non-Microsoft app holds a tier-1 application permission; no v7 recommendation covers app role assignments.
controls.AAD-15.2: Named list of apps with tier-2 data application permissions; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.DEF-2.1: Closest 2.4.2: Satisfied accepts a Standard OR Strict preset with both its EOP and ATP rules enabled and applying to every recipient, while 2.4.2 requires the Strict preset's EOP and ATP rules enabled and targeting priority accounts, so a Standard-only tenant passes the tool and fails 2.4.2.
controls.DEF-2.2: Judges SpamZapEnabled/PhishZapEnabled (anti-spam) and ZapEnabled (anti-malware) for email; 2.4.4 (the draft's id) audits Get-TeamsProtectionPolicy ZapEnabled for Teams, which the tool does not read, and no v7 recommendation audits email ZAP.
controls.DEF-3.1: No v7 recommendation audits EnableUnauthenticatedSender (not among 2.1.7's listed parameters).
controls.DEF-3.2: No v7 recommendation audits EnableViaTag (not among 2.1.7's listed parameters).
controls.DEF-3.4: Judges High/Critical protection alert policies notifying the monitoring address; 2.1.3 (the draft's id) audits the malware filter's EnableInternalSenderAdminNotifications/InternalSenderAdminAddress, a different setting, and no v7 recommendation audits alert routing generally.
controls.DEF-4.2: Closest 3.2.1: Satisfied requires an enabled rule matching sensitive information types in a Mode = Enable policy but never checks the policy's locations, so an Endpoint-only policy passes the tool while 3.2.1 needs Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams.
controls.DEF-4.3: No v7 recommendation covers an OAuth consent alert policy.
controls.DEF-4.5: No v7 recommendation covers Endpoint DLP (3.2.x audits Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams locations).
controls.DEF-4.6: No v7 recommendation covers Attack Simulation Training campaigns.
controls.DEF-5.1: No v7 recommendation covers Tenant Allow/Block List expiry.
controls.DNS-1.2: Satisfied means selector1 and selector2 CNAMEs are published in DNS; 2.1.9 audits Get-DkimSigningConfig Enabled True and Status Valid (signing state), which published CNAMEs do not establish (EXO-1.4 is the closer control).
controls.DNS-1.3: Satisfied requires p=quarantine/reject at pct 100 and a rua address but never checks ruf=, which 2.1.10 requires, and the tool leaves the tenant .onmicrosoft.com domain out of the domain list 2.1.10 audits.
controls.DNS-2.1: No v7 recommendation covers DKIM key rotation age; 2.1.9 audits only signing state.
controls.DNS-2.2: No v7 recommendation covers CAA records.
controls.DNS-2.3: No v7 recommendation covers mail-host TLS certificate expiry.
controls.DNS-2.4: No v7 recommendation covers certificate transparency logs.
controls.EXO-1.5: Closest 2.1.7: Satisfied accepts any TargetedDomainProtectionAction / MailboxIntelligenceProtectionAction (and, when priority users are approved, TargetedUserProtectionAction) other than NoAction, e.g. MoveToJmf, Redirect, Delete or BccMessage, while 2.1.7 requires Quarantine for all three.
controls.EXO-2.3: No v7 recommendation covers POP3 (CAS mailbox plan / Get-CASMailbox PopEnabled).
controls.EXO-2.4: No v7 recommendation covers IMAP4 (CAS mailbox plan / Get-CASMailbox ImapEnabled).
controls.EXO-3.3: No v7 recommendation covers an alert policy for forwarding/redirect rule creation (6.2.1 audits blocking, not alerting).
controls.EXO-3.4: No v7 recommendation covers an alert policy for unusual mail volume or user-reported phish.
controls.EXO-4.1: No v7 recommendation covers audit record retention (Purview audit retention policies of 180+ days); 6.1.2 only notes the 180-day Audit (Standard) retention.
controls.EXO-4.2: Satisfied requires AdminAuditLogEnabled = True; 3.1.1 audits UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled, a different setting (EXO-3.5 judges it), and no v7 recommendation audits AdminAuditLogEnabled.
controls.EXO-4.4: Satisfied judges the default anti-spam policy's SpamAction (MoveToJmf/Quarantine), BulkThreshold <= 6, SpamZapEnabled and PhishZapEnabled; it never reads AllowedSenderDomains (2.1.14) and no v7 recommendation audits those three settings.
controls.EXO-5.2: Closest 2.1.7 (EnableTargetedUserProtection True, TargetedUsersToProtect populated, TargetedUserProtectionAction Quarantine): Satisfied accepts any action other than NoAction (MoveToJmf, Redirect, Delete, BccMessage...). 2.4.1 (the draft's id) audits Get-EmailTenantSettings EnablePriorityAccountProtection, user tags and alert policies, none of which this evaluator reads.
controls.EXO-6.1: Satisfied means no mailbox ForwardingSmtpAddress/ForwardingAddress resolves externally; 6.2.1 audits transport-rule redirects and outbound-policy AutoForwardingMode, not per-mailbox forwarding properties, so a clean mailbox list does not establish that forwarding is blocked.
controls.EXO-6.4: Judges per-mailbox CASMailbox SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled overrides and scores Satisfied even when the organization setting was not read; 6.5.4 audits only Get-TransportConfig SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled = True (EXO-1.2).
controls.EXO-7.1: Same evidence as EXO-6.1 (mailbox ForwardingSmtpAddress/ForwardingAddress); 6.2.1 audits transport rules and outbound-policy AutoForwardingMode, not mailbox forwarding properties.
controls.EXO-7.2: Judges inbox rules that forward/redirect externally; 6.2.1's audit is transport-rule redirects and AutoForwardingMode Off, not inbox-rule contents, so no external inbox rule today does not establish that forwarding is blocked.
controls.EXO-7.4: Judges per-mailbox SMTP AUTH overrides and is Satisfied even when the organization setting was not read; 6.5.4 audits only the organization Get-TransportConfig SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled.
controls.EXO-8.1: No v7 recommendation covers inbound/outbound connector TLS and scoping.
controls.EXO-9.1: No v7 recommendation covers litigation hold / retention policy coverage of mailboxes.
controls.INT-1.1: Closest is 4.1 (deviceManagement/settings secureByDefault = True), but the evaluator judges assigned compliance policies per enrolled platform and their non-compliance actions and never reads secureByDefault (no evaluator does), so it does not judge R's setting.
controls.INT-1.2: Closest is 5.2.2.9, but Satisfied (Get-TPCADeviceComplianceCoverage / Test-TPCAGrantRequires -Any compliantDevice,domainJoinedDevice) accepts an enabled all-users/all-apps policy whose grant requires only domainJoinedDevice, or compliantDevice AND other controls; 5.2.2.9 requires BuiltInControls to contain compliantDevice, nothing other than compliantDevice/domainJoinedDevice, and operator OR, so a hybrid-join-only policy passes the tool and fails R (same judgment as AAD-2.3).
controls.INT-1.3: Windows compliance policies requiring BitLocker/storage encryption; no v7 recommendation (5.1.4.6 is BitLocker key recovery by users).
controls.INT-1.4: App protection (MAM) policies; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-1.5: Defender Antivirus Intune policy (judged against the CIS Intune benchmark, not the M365 benchmark); no v7 M365 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.1: EDR onboarding policy; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.2: ASR rules policy; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.3: Windows Firewall policy; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.4: macOS FileVault compliance; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.5: Windows Update rings; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-2.6: Office macro and active-content Intune policy (judged against the CIS Intune for Office benchmark, not the M365 benchmark); no v7 M365 recommendation covers Office client macro settings.
controls.INT-3.1: Closest is 4.2, but Satisfied is ANY block in ANY platform-restriction row (platform blocked, personal blocked, or just a minimum OS version on one non-windowsMobile platform), while 4.2 requires the priority-0 default policy to block personally owned enrollment (or the platform) on every platform; e.g. a minimum iOS version alone passes the tool and fails R.
controls.INT-3.2: App configuration policies; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-3.3: App protection conditional-launch minimum OS; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-4.1: Closest is 5.1.4.5 (Entra deviceRegistrationPolicy localAdminPassword.isEnabled = True), but the evaluator only counts assigned Intune Windows LAPS policies and never reads the Entra tenant switch, so it does not judge R's setting.
controls.INT-4.2: Windows Hello for Business enrollment configuration; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-4.3: Minimum OS version in compliance policies plus 90% device compliance; no v7 recommendation.
controls.INT-4.4: Mobile compliance passcode required; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-1.1: Power Platform tenant isolation; v7 section 9 covers Fabric/Power BI only, no Power Platform recommendation.
controls.PPL-1.2: Power Platform DLP policies exist; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-1.3: Power Platform environment creation restriction; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-2.1: Power Platform connector classification; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-2.2: Power Automate guest flows (usually manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-2.3: Power Apps portal creation; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-3.1: Satisfied when sensitivity labels exist (Get-Label count) and an auto-label policy is in Mode Enable; it does not read label publishing policies, so it does not judge 3.3.1's setting, and no v7 rec covers auto-labeling.
controls.PPL-3.2: Closest is 3.2.3, but Satisfied is any DLP policy whose Workloads include Copilot/M365Copilot/CopilotExperiences/Applications or whose name contains "Copilot", with no Mode filter (the collector copies Enabled but the evaluator never checks it) and no LocationInclusions All check; 3.2.3 requires Mode Enable and LocationInclusions All, so a test-mode or disabled Copilot DLP policy passes the tool and fails R.
controls.PPL-3.3: Copilot license ratio; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PPL-3.4: Always NotApplicable (Copilot Studio publishing, manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-1.2: Judges audit retention policies under 90 days; no v7 recommendation covers audit retention.
controls.PVW-2.2: Communication compliance policies; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-2.3: Information barriers mode; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-2.4: Always NotApplicable (Insider Risk, manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-2.5: Retention policy workload coverage; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-2.6: Auto-labeling policy in Mode Enable; no v7 recommendation (3.3.1 is label publishing policies, not auto-labeling).
controls.PVW-3.1: Always NotApplicable (SIEM export, manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-3.2: Always NotApplicable (eDiscovery readiness, manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-3.3: Always NotApplicable (Compliance Manager, manual); no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-3.4: Closest is 3.2.1, but Satisfied is an enabled rule using a sensitive information type in a Mode-Enable policy, without checking that the policy has an Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams location, so the same Endpoint-only gap as PVW-1.3 applies.
controls.PVW-4.1: Audit (Premium) licensing per user; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-4.2: Audit retention policy of 365+ days; no v7 recommendation.
controls.PVW-4.4: Record (IsRecordLabel) retention labels; no v7 recommendation.
controls.SPO-1.2: Closest is 7.2.7 (DefaultSharingLinkType must be Direct or Internal), but the evaluator scores Satisfied from SharingCapability alone (disabled/existingExternalUserSharingOnly/externalUserSharingOnly) without reading DefaultSharingLinkType, so a tenant whose default link type is AnonymousAccess or None while Anyone links are off passes the tool and fails R's audit; only the Anyone-enabled branch reads the link type (Internal/Direct = Satisfied).
controls.SPO-1.5: No v7 recommendation covers the SharePoint unmanaged-device ConditionalAccessPolicy setting (7.3.1 is DisallowInfectedFileDownload; 5.2.2.9 is a CA grant, not this SharePoint setting).
controls.SPO-2.1: No v7 recommendation covers the OneDrive sync restriction to domain-joined computers (IsUnmanagedSyncAppForTenantRestricted).
controls.SPO-2.2: No v7 recommendation covers Anyone-link expiration (RequireAnonymousLinksExpireInDays); v7 7.2.x has no link-expiry rec.
controls.SPO-2.3: Always NotApplicable (not collected); no v7 recommendation covers SharePoint store app installation.
controls.SPO-2.4: Always NotApplicable (per-site custom script); no v7 recommendation covers custom script (v7 section 7.3 has only 7.3.1).
controls.SPO-2.8: No v7 recommendation covers the OneDrive sync domain-GUID restriction.
controls.SPO-3.1: Always NotApplicable (manual review of site collection admins); no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.SPO-3.3: No v7 recommendation covers the org version-history default (EnableAutoExpirationVersionTrim / MajorVersionLimit).
controls.TMS-1.5: Judges Purview retention policies covering OneDrive/SharePoint for recordings; no v7 recommendation covers this.
controls.TMS-1.6: Closest is 5.1.6.3 (allowInvitesFrom adminsAndGuestInviters or none), but the evaluator is Satisfied whenever Teams AllowGuestUser = False regardless of allowInvitesFrom, so a tenant with invitations open to everyone passes the tool and fails R; no v7 Teams rec covers AllowGuestUser.
controls.TMS-2.1: Always NotApplicable (Skype consumer interop retired); no v7 recommendation.
controls.TMS-2.5: Always NotApplicable (enforced by the platform: externals cannot start recording); 8.5.9 is AllowCloudRecording off for everyone, a different subject.
controls.TMS-2.6: Judges AllowChannelMeetingScheduling; no v7 recommendation covers it.
controls.TMS-3.4: Closest is 3.2.2, but Satisfied needs only one Mode-Enable DLP policy whose Workload matches Teams; 3.2.2 also requires TeamsLocation to include All (and exceptions permitted), which the evaluator does not read, so a policy scoped to named teams passes the tool and fails R.
controls.TMS-4.4: Judges events policy attendee access (webinars, town halls, legacy live events); no v7 recommendation.
controls.AAD-6.4: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations v7.0.0 predates Microsoft Entra Agent ID and has no recommendation on agent identity blueprints; 5.1.2.2 audits allowedToCreateApps, a different setting that Microsoft documents does not restrict agent blueprints.
